high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Inc42, a news website, dated July 17, 2024. The headline reads: "Consumer Lighting Startup Corvi LED Bags $8 Mn From Enam Investments." The article is authored by Krithika K L. The summary section highlights the following points: Corvi LED raises $8 Mn (INR 65.6 Cr) in Series B funding from Enam Investments. The company plans to focus on both B2C and B2B segments, introducing new LED products with emphasis on design and aesthetics. Founded in 2
